❖ DEEP LEARNING PIPELINE ARCHITECTURE

Uncertainty-Aware Graph Neural Investigation Pipeline

End-to-end synergy: GraphSAGE node representations + Denoising Autoencoder anomaly scoring + MC-Dropout epistemic uncertainty quantification driving an expected-cost Next-Best-Action policy with institutional case memory.

01

Data & Temporal Split

Strict 70/15/15 temporal partition on TransactionDT. Eliminates future leakage; natural ~3.5% fraud rate preserved.

02

Graph & Hub Capping

Card-transaction-device bipartite links. Hub degree capped at 50 to prevent generic browser devices from blurring ring clusters.

DAE Anomaly Scoring

Denoising Autoencoder trained exclusively on legitimate train rows. Reconstruction MSE isolates novel zero-day anomalies.
